<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadowCard" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="10" stdDeviation="10" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="shadowBar" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="-2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
    <style>
      .t1{font-family:Poppins, sans-serif;fill:#050505}
      .t2{font-family:Poppins, sans-serif;fill:#4E4B66}
      .t3{font-family:Poppins, sans-serif;fill:#667080}
      .t4{font-family:Poppins, sans-serif;fill:#1877F2}
      .white{fill:#FFFFFF}
      .muted{fill:#A0A3BD}
    </style>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="24" class="t1" font-size="15" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(304,13)">
      <rect x="0" y="8" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
      <rect x="5" y="6" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
      <rect x="10" y="4" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
      <rect x="15" y="2" width="3" height="14" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(327,10)">
      <circle cx="6" cy="8" r="4.2" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <circle cx="6" cy="8" r="1.8" fill="#050505"/>
      <line x1="10.8" y1="11.5" x2="14.2" y2="14.9" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(343,12)">
      <rect x="0" y="5" width="16" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <rect x="16.4" y="8.2" width="1.8" height="3.6" rx="0.8" fill="#050505"/>
      <rect x="1.4" y="6.4" width="10.6" height="7.2" rx="1.2" fill="#050505"/>

  </g>

  <!-- Header/profile -->

    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="202" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="101" r="51" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="101" r="46" fill="#DDE3EA"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="101" r="42" fill="#F5F5F5"/>
    <text x="195" y="108" text-anchor="middle" class="t1" font-size="24" font-weight="700">WF</text>

    <text x="195" y="181" text-anchor="middle" class="t1" font-size="24" font-weight="700">Wilson Franci</text>
    <text x="195" y="201" text-anchor="middle" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">@wilsonfranci • San Francisco</text>

    <text x="195" y="223" text-anchor="middle" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Tech reporter and product storyteller covering</text>
    <text x="195" y="239" text-anchor="middle" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">startups, design systems, and the future of media.</text>
    <text x="195" y="255" text-anchor="middle" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Building a better daily news habit, one feature at a time.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Stats -->
  <g filter="url(#shadowCard)">
    <rect x="16" y="272" width="358" height="86" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <line x1="135" y1="286" x2="135" y2="344" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="255" y1="286" x2="255" y2="344" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="76" y="309" text-anchor="middle" class="t1" font-size="24" font-weight="700">42.8K</text>
    <text x="76" y="332" text-anchor="middle" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Followers</text>

    <text x="195" y="309" text-anchor="middle" class="t1" font-size="24" font-weight="700">1,284</text>
    <text x="195" y="332" text-anchor="middle" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Following</text>

    <text x="314" y="309" text-anchor="middle" class="t1" font-size="24" font-weight="700">196</text>
    <text x="314" y="332" text-anchor="middle" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">News</text>
  </g>

    </g>
    <g>

  </g>

    <text x="187" y="464" text-anchor="middle" class="t3" font-size="14" font-weight="600">About</text>
    <text x="291" y="464" text-anchor="middle" class="t3" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Tagged</text>

  <!-- Section header -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="514" class="t1" font-size="20" font-weight="700">Recent news</text>
    <text x="328" y="514" text-anchor="end" class="t4" font-size="14" font-weight="600">See all</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Article card 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadowCard)">
    <rect x="16" y="526" width="358" height="122" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="538" width="98" height="98" rx="12" fill="#EEF1F4"/>

    <polygon points="72,600 86,579 100,600" fill="#A0A3BD"/>

    <text x="142" y="556" class="t4" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Tech</text>
    <text x="142" y="578" class="t1" font-size="16" font-weight="700">Startup funding cools as founders</text>
    <text x="142" y="596" class="t1" font-size="16" font-weight="700">double down on efficiency</text>
    <text x="142" y="617" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">A roundup of the week’s biggest rounds,</text>
    <text x="142" y="633" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">product pivots, and layoffs.</text>
    <text x="142" y="654" class="t2" font-size="12" font-weight="400">2h ago • 18 min read</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Article card 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadowCard)">
    <rect x="16" y="660" width="358" height="122" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="672" width="98" height="98" rx="12" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="703" r="11" fill="#1877F2"/>

    <text x="142" y="690" class="t4" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Product</text>
    <text x="142" y="712" class="t1" font-size="16" font-weight="700">The news habit is changing how</text>
    <text x="142" y="730" class="t1" font-size="16" font-weight="700">readers save and share stories</text>
    <text x="142" y="751" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">A look at curation tools, bookmarks, and</text>
    <text x="142" y="767" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">the rise of personalized briefings.</text>
    <text x="142" y="788" class="t2" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Yesterday • 6 min read</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Article card 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadowCard)">
    <rect x="16" y="794" width="358" height="122" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="806" width="98" height="98" rx="12" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <rect x="38" y="844" width="78" height="16" rx="8" fill="#34EAB9"/>

    <circle cx="68" cy="828" r="6" fill="#00BA88"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="832" r="8" fill="#00BA88"/>
    <rect x="28" y="806" width="98" height="98" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="#EEF1F4"/>

    <text x="142" y="824" class="t4" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Media</text>
    <text x="142" y="846" class="t1" font-size="16" font-weight="700">Newsrooms are leaning into short</text>
    <text x="142" y="864" class="t1" font-size="16" font-weight="700">video and live updates</text>
    <text x="142" y="885" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Coverage strategies from editors at fast-</text>
    <text x="142" y="901" class="t2" font-size="13" font-weight="400">moving digital publications.</text>
    <text x="142" y="922" class="t2" font-size="12" font-weight="400">3 days ago • 9 min read</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g filter="url(#shadowBar)">
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->

      <polygon points="18,6 30,16 6,16" fill="#A0A3BD"/>

      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" class="t3" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <g transform="translate(112,780)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="15" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="24" y1="21" x2="30" y2="27" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" class="t3" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <g transform="translate(194,780)">
      <rect x="10" y="6" width="16" height="26" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="10,32 18,26 26,32" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" class="t3" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile active -->
    <g transform="translate(276,780)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="13" r="7" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="8" y="22" width="20" height="10" rx="5" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" class="t4" font-size="11" font-weight="600">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <!-- More -->
    <g transform="translate(348,780)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="16" r="1.8" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="1.8" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
      <circle cx="26" cy="16" r="1.8" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
      <text x="18" y="48" text-anchor="middle" class="t3" font-size="11" font-weight="600">More</text>
    </g>
